name: Hooters
description: Enjoy world famous wings and a great beer selection at Hooters of Gulf Shores. Eat-in or carryout, the best food in Alabama can always be found right in Gulf Shores. Daily happy hour specials, drink specials and craft beer on tap. Hooters is known for its craveable food, cold beer, and all the sports you could possibly watch on wall-to-wall big screen TVs, along with the iconic Hooters Girls hospitality. From humble beginnings in 1983 in Clearwater, Florida, the Hooters brand has grown into an international sensation with more than 420 Hooters restaurants in 42 states and 29 countries. We serve world-famous Hooters wings, appetizers, burgers, sandwiches, tacos, seafood, salads, fries and sides, and desserts. Whether your preference is bottles, cans or a wide variety of beers on tap, we've got you covered.
address_line_1: 300 E Beach Blvd, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA
